answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Every claim climbs the garden of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the lotus re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, unlocked only after continuous uptime, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the ferrous of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
